2120. Printing the Multiplication Table of a Number

65

Problem Statement
Read an integer and print its multiplication table from 1 to 10 using a for loop.

Description
Read an integer num from input. Use a for loop with a counter running from 1 to 10. On each iteration, print num, the counter, and their product in the format "num x counter = product".
input_spec:
. Use a for loop with a counter running from 1 to 10. On each iteration, print num, the counter, and their product in the format "num x counter = product".

Input Description
A single integer num.
output_spec: Print 10 lines showing num multiplied by each value from 1 to 10.
